events.todo: Not sure how to handle this. The HTML parser treats iframe like it can't contain other tags, so anything up to a closing iframe tag is text. If it's self-closed or not closed, then everything up to the end is considered text. Currently this means that all text after an unclosed iframe is wiped out and not saved to the db -- see LJ::parse_embed_module
